header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Ahmed Murtaza A. Arab advocate for the petitioner.
body: 2. Through this application, the petitioner seeks restoration of the petition, which was dismissed on 11.11.2026 for non-prosecution. Perusal of the grounds mentioned in the application, supported by an affidavit are tenable. Learned A.A.G appearing in other cases, waives notice and raised no objection for allowing the application. Accordingly, the listed application is allowed and the petition is restored to its original stage.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner moved an application before the Regional Director, Sindh Building Control Authority (SBCA), Shaheed Benazirabad, but the same has not yet been decided by him. Under these circumstances, the petition is disposed of with directions to the Regional Director, Sindh Building Control Authority (SBCA), Shaheed Benazirabad (Respondent No. 4) to decide the application of the petitioner within a period of thirty (30) days in accordance with law.
The petition stands disposed of in the above terms.
